mainEntity.name: How can I make AI prospect scoring accurate enough to trust?

acceptedAnswer.text: Start by defining what a qualified prospect means for your business, then assign consistent fields such as industry, size, location, need signal, decision-maker role, source, and confidence. Use scoring to prioritize review, not to make automatic judgments. Test the score against a sample of accounts and adjust it when high-ranked prospects are poor fits. Keep disqualifiers visible so the system does not reward volume alone. Run My AI Biz’s task-specific assistant model can organize this process around the workflow you actually use.
acceptedAnswer.description: Define qualification criteria and disqualifiers before scoring. Require fields for fit, need signal, source, recency, and confidence, then compare scores with human judgments on a sample. Revise the model when high-ranked accounts do not produce relevant conversations.
